raw_title: “Having Fun and Learning Something”: How Users in Four Countries Define What News Is – and Is Not
title_en: “Having Fun and Learning Something”: How Users in Four Countries Define What News Is – and Is Not
title_zh: “Having Fun and Learning Something”: How Users in Four Countries Define What News Is – and Is Not
plain_summary_en: This paper studies “Having Fun and Learning Something”: How Users in Four Countries Define What News Is – and Is Not. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is definition of news, news consumption, cross-cultural comparison. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
